fact: The finance ministry's 2024 annual report says that by the fourth quarter of 2024 Janjanbureh and Kuntaur Area Councils had functional internet connections operational, giving internet access to most of their offices, that Banjul City Council had a 100 Mbps connection and Kuntaur had upgraded to 10 Mbps, while Janjanbureh and Kerewan still struggled with unreliable internet; IFMIS is implemented in the Local Government Area Councils, most of them actively using it.
title: 2024 Public Finance Management Annual Progress Report
publisher: PFMD Directorate, Ministry of Finance and Economic Affairs
